evidence.notes: Queued local Queueable and Schedulable jobs can be aborted before Test.stopTest; completed and unknown jobs remain explicit unsupported diagnostics.

source.content: public class AbortQueue { public void execute(QueueableContext qc) { System.assert(false, 'aborted queueable should not run'); } }
public class AbortSchedule { public void execute(SchedulableContext sc) { System.assert(false, 'aborted scheduled job should not run'); } }

@isTest private class AsyncAbortJobEdgesTest { @isTest static void abortsQueuedJobsBeforeStopTest() { Test.startTest(); String queueId = System.enqueueJob(new AbortQueue()); String scheduleId = System.schedule('nightly', '0 0 0 * * ?', new AbortSchedule()); System.abortJob(queueId); System.abortJob(scheduleId); Test.stopTest(); Integer abortedJobs = [SELECT COUNT() FROM AsyncApexJob WHERE Status = 'Aborted']; System.assertEquals(2, abortedJobs); Integer deletedCrons = [SELECT COUNT() FROM CronTrigger WHERE State = 'Deleted']; System.assertEquals(1, deletedCrons); } }
